tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_clergy_max_literacy = 10
		local_pop_conversion_speed = 10
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = laborers
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = infrastructure_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time
	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	modifier = {
		local_production_efficiency = 0.2
		local_peasants_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 6
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = small_fort_building
	construction_demand = fort_construction

	modifier = {
		local_defensive = 0.1
		local_manpower_modifier = 0.1
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 27
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = government_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	build_time = large_cultural_building_time

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 1
		local_trade_center_power = 0.1
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = government_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = government_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 32
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
